purpose: Bind current semantic graph and lifecycle identities to an exact executable CompiledGraph for proof correlation without changing Burn programIdentity or execution.

validation.registry_binding: supplied CompiledGraph must validate against the current LayerRegistry
validation.builder_graph_match: recompiling the supplied AgentGraphBuilder to the CompiledGraph output slot must reproduce the exact canonical plan and programIdentity
validation.failure: mismatch fails closed before a semantic proof context is emitted

identity.context_fingerprint: fnv1a64 over exact programIdentity + semanticGraphIdentity + semanticLifecycleIdentity + lifecycle coverage flag
identity.fingerprint_security: deterministic correlation only; not a cryptographic signature

coverage.lifecycle_coverage_complete: true when every graph step has a semantic lifecycle transition
coverage.policy: incomplete semantic lifecycle remains representable; the context reports it rather than silently rejecting it

workspaceVerifySemanticGraphReceipt.semantic_context: derived and validated from current builder + graph + registry

invariants: semantic execution context never changes executable graph plan bytes
semantic execution context never changes Burn programIdentity
semantic execution context never mutates AgentGraphBuilder or LayerRegistry
semantic execution context does not authorize execution or choose semantic roles
a foreign or stale builder cannot relabel an already compiled graph
semantic-only changes may change context_fingerprint while programIdentity remains identical
numerical verifier authority remains Burn CompiledGraph execution; semantic context is provenance carried alongside that proof
